presets.name: Studio DI
presets.desc: A clean DI that sounds miked: a touch of tube push, the smooth speaker emulation, flat EQ
presets.notes: The SansAmp-style use: Blend full, Drive low; the cab's smoothing does most of the work. Turn cab Off before an IR

presets.name: Warm Push
presets.desc: Power-stage push that blooms when dug in, rounded top, the clean under it for the low end
presets.notes: Sag above half lets the power stage sag more on hard notes

presets.name: Modern Grind
presets.desc: CMOS-style grind blended over a full clean, growl boosted at 1.5 kHz, low mids scooped
presets.notes: The coherent blend keeps the clean lows at full weight under the grind; Hi Mid at 1.5 kHz is the growl

presets.name: Tight Five
presets.desc: Grind for 5- and 6-strings: lows below 110 Hz kept clean, mono and out of the cab
presets.notes: low_note comes from the lane's tuning; Grunt −6 and Bass Keep keep the low B out of the clipper

presets.name: Drop Growl
presets.desc: Drop-tuned growl: heavy grind with the hi-mid bark, clean low end held under 90 Hz
presets.notes: Bass Keep is the guarantee that the fundamental of a drop-A string never thins in the blend

presets.name: Valve Grit
presets.desc: Low-gain valve grind with the mids forward and a darker top, through a sealed 8×10
presets.notes: Sag at its default moves the bias with the playing: the grind blooms when dug in

presets.name: Ultra Scoop
presets.desc: Scooped valve DI: −10 dB at 500 Hz, a little more bass and top, light grit
presets.notes: The valve DI's 'ultra low' switch as a preset: the Lo Mid cut at 500 Hz does it

presets.name: Slap Even
presets.desc: Compressor before everything evens slap and pop; a hint of grit, bass and treble up, mids cut
presets.notes: Comp Path Both: the clean is compressed too, so the thumb and the pop come out level

presets.name: Engine Grind
presets.desc: Compressed grind blended with an uncompressed clean: an even dirt, the dynamics kept underneath
presets.notes: The compressor sits in the dirt only (the amp-head engine's way): the clean keeps every accent

presets.name: Fuzz Wall Low
presets.desc: Full-gain grind with the treble pushed into the clipper: a synth-like fuzz wall over the clean
presets.notes: 8× oversampling and the interstage low-pass keep the aliases about 100 dB under the note at full gain

presets.name: Into the IR
presets.desc: Modern grind with the speaker emulation off, for a cab IR block after it
presets.notes: Cab Off: the IR (golem's cab block) does the speaker; golem writes Off when a cab follows

presets.name: Grit Blend Pedal
presets.desc: Clean to grit on the expression pedal: the blend sweeps without thinning, the lows never move
presets.notes: Put Blend on the EXP pedal (0 → 70 %); Bass Keep 100 Hz keeps the fundamental clean at every point

presets.name: Guitar DI
presets.desc: The tube-emulation DI on guitar: corners scaled to the guitar's low E, smooth speaker
presets.notes: golem sets low_note to 82.4 Hz on a guitar lane: every low corner moves up an octave with it
